EmailTemplate.name: LDAP New Account Welcome
EmailTemplate.Body:
Hello $firstName $lastName,
Your new $applicationName account has been created. You can sign in with the credentials below:
Username: $username Temporary password: $password
For security reasons, please sign in and change your password immediately.
If you did not expect this account, contact the IT Service Desk.
Regards, Identity & Access Management
EmailTemplate.Description: Welcome email sent after a new LDAP account is created.
EmailTemplate.Subject: Your new $applicationName account is ready
